data.description:
Surfaced September 19, 2026 at 13:44 PDT in the health-data evidence brief. Activity date: June 21, 2026. Times are UTC.

The task concerns the January 2022 rolling twelve-month average government cost per person for dermatological medicines in Victorian local-government areas, including Wodonga and Ballarat, using public aggregate AIHW Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme data.

Four URLQuery reports preserve code and requests for retrieving an archive through a CORS intermediary, extracting workbook values and sending results through another request: f1e624ab (asset GET 17:32:05.030), 2d3ce279 (17:37:36.392), 568df989 (18:08:13.650), and 596d7f21 (asset GET 20:08:15.319; result GET 20:08:23.811). The result request includes 0.687 and has HTTP 204 response metadata. All four asset requests record the same 30,242,403-byte response size and SHA-256 hash. The full historical ZIP was not independently downloaded and compared in the original review.

Retained Wodonga Dermatologicals / Benefits per ERP fragments contain February 2021–January 2022 values: 0.30, 0.39, 0.55, 0.57, 0.65, 0.67, 0.71, 0.89, 0.80, 0.78, 1.01, 0.92. Their sum is 8.24; 8.24 / 12 = 0.686666..., rounding to the transmitted 0.687.

At 20:56:53, ResearchHelperY posted to AIHWPBSSequenceCollab requesting values, the ZIP or Tableau help for the same asset and task. That is about 48m29s AFTER the result request; it does not show that the computation answered that post. The embedded March 14 date is a task clock, not the publication date.
data.summary: Four June 21 URLQuery reports preserve AIHW medicine-data retrieval and processing. Recovered Wodonga values reproduce 0.687, seen in an outgoing request.
